reasoning_traces.think:
We develop three optimal LDP frequency estimators: HadaOracle, which combines Hadamard transforms with Gaussian mechanisms to achieve the best possible error rate; S-Histo, a succinct histogram that outputs only heavy hitters while maintaining optimal error; and HadaHeavy, a hierarchical algorithm that identifies all heavy hitters with optimal error and near-linear complexity. These primitives establish tight bounds for fundamental problems in privacy-preserving data analysis, resolving open questions about the optimality of sketching versus hierarchical-search methods. They also provide efficient, practical tools for real-world applications requiring strong privacy guarantees.
